governance_bootstrap.summary: Completion requires exact test, push, deployment, and runtime verification state.
Origin/main is deployment source of truth and production claims require real entrypoint evidence.

codex_cli_rule: Codex CLI uses caveman ultra by default unless explicitly disabled; code change summaries must keep changed files, verification, commit, and deploy state exact.
problem: A fresh OpenClaw Saju query failed and reused an older answer instead of returning the newly calculated daewoon-aware result.
root_cause: The live OpenClaw trajectory recorded codex_dynamic_tool_rpc timeoutMs=90000 for harness_saju_query.
The Saju bridge permits up to 300 seconds and fresh NotebookLM calls can exceed 90 seconds, so the outer dynamic-tool watchdog terminated valid work first.
changes: plugins/harness-bridge/index.js: require timeoutSeconds=300 in harness_saju_query arguments so OpenClaw applies its documented 30-second grace and a 330-second dynamic-tool watchdog.
tests/test_harness_bridge_plugin.mjs: assert the required fixed timeout contract.

verification.name: Local plugin and Saju regressions
verification.command: node --check plugins/harness-bridge/index.js; node tests/test_harness_bridge_plugin.mjs; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_openclaw_bridge.py tests/test_openclaw_saju_bridge_timeout.py tests/test_notebook_query_planning.py

verification.name: Mac Mini OpenClaw production replay
verification.command: openclaw agent --agent main --session-key diag-saju-dynamic-timeout-final-20260729 --json --timeout 420 --message <daewoon-aware fresh query>
verification.result: status ok; durationMs 170911; fallbackUsed false; harness_saju_query failures 0; trajectory arguments included timeoutSeconds=300; final answer included 10-year daewoon, seun, wolun, iljin, and daewoon confirmation limits.

verification.name: Mac Mini plugin health
verification.command: openclaw plugins install --force <harness-bridge>; openclaw daemon restart; openclaw plugins doctor
verification.result: plugin installed and gateway restarted; No plugin issues detected.

deploy.method: scripts/deploy_to_macmini.sh with three selected paths, followed by forced plugin install and gateway restart
deploy.result: selected deployed paths matched origin/main with zero diff; production replay succeeded after 170.911 seconds.

operational_note: Fresh NotebookLM work can still take several minutes, but the OpenClaw dynamic-tool watchdog now allows the bridge's full query budget instead of failing at 90 seconds.
